The “Boost Your Manifestation Power” Meditation draws upon Agesta’s sacred codes to spark transformative energy in your life. To see significant changes, commit to practising this meditation for 9, 15, or 21 days.

For expedited results, it is recommended that you first complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions.

Sacred codes are seen as sequences of numbers that help connect individuals with higher frequencies, bring intentions into reality, and support the healing process. Introduced by channellers such as Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), these sequences are believed to come from beings of light and act as a spiritual technology designed to uplift human consciousness.

To work with a sacred code, simply repeat the numerical sequence—either in your mind or aloud—while maintaining a meditative state. This unique combination of numerology, meditation, and energy healing has led many to share positive experiences. Whether you are pursuing manifestation, healing, or spiritual growth, these numerical sequences continue to serve as a captivating tool in modern esoteric practices.
